name: precision-test-selector
description: GitHub Actions plugin for precision test selection based on coverage data

scripts.build: tsc && ncc build dist/index.js --license licenses.txt && rm -rf dist/test_selector && mkdir -p dist/test_selector && cp src/*.py dist/test_selector/ && cp -r src/repos dist/test_selector/
scripts.package: npm run build && zip -r precision-test-v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").zip dist/ action.yml

author: openlibing
